page.overview:
Who is Stanley Pickman?

Stanley Pickman is a fictional character created by Ian Davey for his short Cthulhu Mythos story "Black Letter Day". At the culminations of the events of "The Epiphany of Dissolution", he is revealed to be an avatar of Nyarlathotep.

At first appearing as an older man who claims a professorship in an unknown subject, after the fall of mankind and return of the Old Ones, Stanley Pickman looked considerably younger, as if the global catastrophe has somehow rejuvenated him. Later, in a confrontation with Glyph and Lucy, Pickman was obliterated when Nyarlathotep fully manifested and called forth his fellow Outer God Yog-Sothoth.

Category:Avatars of Nyarlathotep Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Deceased (In Mythos)
